profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Engineering leader with 8 years of experience architecting and scaling distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, and developer tooling. Proven track record in building high-performance engineering teams, leading cross-functional initiatives, and delivering mission-critical infrastructure. Expertise in Kubernetes, DevOps, event-driven systems, data analytics, and algorithm development. Passionate about cultivating engineering excellence and aligning technical strategy with business outcomes.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team & Leadership
• Lead and mentor engineering team; own performance, growth, and technical direction
• Technical lead for AI platform initiative; drive architecture and cross-team execution
• Partner with leadership to define platform strategy and roadmap

Platform & Cloud Architecture
• Architect Kubernetes platforms on AWS using Talos and Crossplane
• Design end-to-end AI cluster architecture (CNI, CSI, security, GitOps)
• Lead GitOps adoption with Flux across multi-cluster environments
• Build IDPs with Keycloak, ArgoCD, Backstage, Gitea
• Restored CI/CD by rebuilding Helm testing pipelines

Tooling & Developer Experience
• Built Go CLI for management cluster provisioning and lifecycle automation
• Standardized deployments with Helm + GitHub Actions
• Enabled ephemeral Kubernetes environments for IaC development
• Developed analytics pipelines (Pandas, Polars) and automated testing (Pytest, Locust)

AI & Distributed Systems
• Lead engineering for Kubernetes-based AI platform (training, inference, observability)
• Built OpenTelemetry + NATS JetStream pipeline for secure cross-cluster telemetry
• Designed Kafka/NATS event-driven system supporting thousands of devices (95% compute reduction)
• Modernized legacy Python systems to async Kafka-based architectures

positions.title: Software Engineer, Co-Founder
positions.description:
Technical Architecture & Analytics
• Architected a 25+ node Talos Cluster for HPC capabilities, to allow automatic horizontal and vertical
scalability of SQL, NoSQL and Backtesting microservices.
• Rewrote a FastAPI Rest service in Golang’s Gin to reduce compute resources, and increase
throughput for critical data retrieval from Postgres for all microservice compute.
• Developed FastAPI services to expose metrics and scoring results from backtesting engine, exposing
both SQL and NoSQL resources.
• Built a Rust-based tool (“Recon”) using hash-based diffs to verify dataset consistency across
sources.

Consulting & Client Work
• Advised early-stage startup companies on infrastructure modernization from RPC synchronous
backend APIs to FastAPI with Celery task queue systems.
• Designed containerized backend systems and deployment strategies for clients transitioning from
monoliths to microservices.
• Provided fractional engineering leadership and architecture reviews for companies seeking to
improve platform reliability and developer velocity.
• Delivered training on GitOps workflows, Kubernetes debugging, and Terraform-based IaC to
internal client teams.
• Helped implement zero-trust policies and secret management using Vault, and KMS.
• Led backend architecture for Web3 container platform deployed to AWS EKS, utilizing FastAPI,
kr8s, Golang’s Gin (for a Helm API), GitHub actions for CI/CD and Terraform.
• Developed KMS open-sourced plugin for secure key handling in the Ape Open Source ecosystem.
• Led infrastructure modernization efforts for startups adopting Kubernetes and GitOps.

positions.title: Systems Engineer III
positions.description:
• Designed and developed FastAPI service for uploading, managing and displaying Cameo model metric data to monitor health metrics.
• Developed Dockerfile for automation of pulling Cameo model metrics, cleaning, and pushing data up to the ReST service.
• Developed macros and manage automation software for Cameo.

positions.title: Senior Project Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed software to automate design process through Autodesk Inventor using Python, projected to reduce product design time by 60%. Will reduce production costs and product prices overall by 5%.
•	Developed tool to pull design criteria from sales team spreadsheets to Autodesk Inventor using selenium and beautiful soup Python packages.  Allows no change to current employee process and reduces product design time by 10%.
•	Software packages have been deployed to Windows server to run on a time schedule. Both monitors and determines when changes have been made to project folders. Eliminates human error and allows for a fully function automated design software package to be deployed.
•	Developed automated pricing tool for entire standard catalog using VBA. Responsible for 10% of revenue.
•	Completes all structural design calculations for pressure vessels and the underlying standing structure using ASCE standards, and Autodesk Inventor’s structural analysis tool. Reduced individual project costs by 1-2% due to an over design on historical standard structural designs.
•	Removed cost of past analyses through development of a finite element analysis process on complex pressure vessel designs for davit arms, nozzle loads, and shell stresses.
•	Removed cost of ASME code calculations for all ASME code vessels prior to fabrication by implementing PVElite into our product design process for ASME code vessels.
•	Developed a calculation tool in accordance with NFPA-68 using excel and Python. Eliminates the cost of outsourcing annual updates to NFPA code calculator.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
•	Coordinated meetings with manufacturing plant leaders to develop a production optimization calculator for the $400m expansion project. This tool prevented severe overlooks of production lines due to health risks of products being produced and bottled in areas that would otherwise not have been properly ventilated.
•	Reduced future expansion project by $50m by developing a production plan that optimized for the least amount of downtime of the production facility. Developed algorithm that accounted for production, cleaning, inspection and error.
•	Integrated architectural, mechanical, and electrical systems using Autodesk’s Revit to reduce contractor costs.
•	Wrote user requirement specifications (URS) for Solidworks project data management system for FDA regulated projects.
•	Identified and specified containment equipment for pharmaceutical manufacturing filling lines.
•	Oversaw project execution and validation.
•	Led  product database for the allocation of 255 million vials of generic pharmaceutical drugs.
•	Led equipment list of expansion project for electrical and utilities connections.
•	Led 3-D modeling and the implementation of equipment models into the project building schematics.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented a 3-D printing prototype machine and the corresponding software
•	Manipulated Mechanics of Materials equations to fit research of electrical connectors
•	Repaired damaged AutoCAD, Inventor, and Solidworks files for manufacturing purposes
•	Researched clock-springs and balancers, in order to prove manufacturing flaws in company product
•	Researched mechanical properties using INSTRON machine and Rockwell Hardness Testing Machine
